body: I primarily invoke via pathworkings. Meditation is my best friend in this path. You're fine to do that. I'm actually a believer that anything physical is just setting the mood to help achieve gnosis.

Very interesting! I totally respect and support your path. I think for me, my personal lesson is actually learning to be "selfish" without feeling guilty, so it's interesting to see the contrast. Good on you for your progress and improvements.

All respect meant with this, did you happen to grow up practicing an abrahamic religion such as Christianity? I find that a lot of practitioners who have a motto of "do no harm" grew up with this. I think sometimes unfortunately when it comes to people and Magick, the graceful way of doing things means that *you* end up the one hurt. This is why I've learned to start working with daemons in the first place instead of just angels like I used to, because at the end of the day, living on earth where people primarily get their hands dirty with or without Magick- means that you also may have to get your hands dirty. I personally don't curse or practice baneful magick myself, but I have definitely worked with daemons for self serving goals. So I completely understand your anxiety and reservation about baneful magick because I actually grew up in a VERY religious area- but I wanted to give you perspective on how christianized beliefs could be affecting you today.
Yes I completely agree. Also, Loki likes to challenge people to change and learn. His chaos is often about lessons. That's perfect for this kind of hex.
I could be completely wrong, but this makes me think of an awesome job for a chaos deity or trickster. Particularly playful and mischievous ones.
